game.name: Fifa 07 (Europe)(Es,Pt)
game.desc: With FIFA 07 on Xbox 360, discover a more realistic version of the game than the previous ones for a game slightly more focused on simulation. There are six leagues, 177 clubs, 37 national teams and all licensed players. Play the career mode which allows you to develop a single player throughout his sporting life. The joys of football and boots are yours!
